newsitem.title: FINLAND: ROCLA SETS FIM 42/SHARE ISSUE PRICE, SEEKS LISTING.
newsitem.headline: ROCLA SETS FIM 42/SHARE ISSUE PRICE, SEEKS LISTING.

text.p: Finnish electric warehouse vehicle maker Rocla Oy said on Monday its initial public offering of 1.93 million shares, or 49.7 percent of share capital, would be priced at 42 markka per share.
The company had submitted an application for a listing of its shares on the Helsinki stock exchange, Rocla said.

Shares would be offered to domestic and foreign institutional investors from May 26 to June 6 at the latest. A domestic retail offering and an offering to company employees would begin on May 28 and also end on June 6 at the latest. Employees would be offered shares at a discount, at 38 markka each, Rocla said.
The selling shareholders had reserved the right to increase the number of shares on offer by at most 400,000 with the lead managers' consent.
Rocla would also offer for subscription by retail and institutional investors up to 425,000 new shares.
The international lead manager of the share offering is Carnegie and the co-lead manager is Postipankki Oy, it said.
